# OrganicSMM

> AI-organic social media growth panel. Real Instagram, YouTube and TikTok engagement delivered with natural patterns — S-curve growth, peak-hour optimisation and ±50% variance — so accounts stay 100% safe.

OrganicSMM is a wallet-based SMM platform with engagement bundles, multi-provider auto-rotation, live delivery previews, subscriptions and 24/7 live chat support. Sign-up is free; pay per order from your wallet.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Product overview, features and pricing highlights.
- [Services](/services): Browse Instagram, YouTube, TikTok and Twitter/X services with prices and speeds.
- [Sign in / Sign up](/auth): Create a free account or log in.
- [Instagram SMM Panel](/instagram-smm-panel): Organic Reels views, likes, followers and story views.
- [YouTube SMM Panel](/youtube-smm-panel): Views, Shorts views, subscribers and watch time.
- [TikTok SMM Panel](/tiktok-smm-panel): Views, likes, followers, shares and saves.
- [Facebook SMM Panel](/facebook-smm-panel): Page likes, followers and Reels views.
- [Telegram SMM Panel](/telegram-smm-panel): Channel members, post views and reactions.
- [Best SMM Panel India](/best-smm-panel-india): Why OrganicSMM ranks for Indian creators, UPI payments.
- [Cheapest SMM Panel](/cheap-smm-panel): Wallet bundle tiers and discounted rates.
- [SMM Panel for Resellers](/smm-panel-for-resellers): Reseller API and wholesale pricing.
